label: Finding-122
title: Front page 'Has anyone been hacked?' gives Amazon's honeypot hit but not Amazon's 'broadly exploited in the wild'
description: data/plain.json cards and facts say Amazon reports 'a decoy server was hit four days before the announcement'. Amazon's own post, in the vault (aws-security-blog-madpot), also says 'PHP2Shell is now being broadly exploited in the wild.' The front page is the most-read page and understates the strongest exploitation statement by a named party; it should carry Amazon's words and say what they rest on (its sensors) beside 'no confirmed break-in'. The coverage review flagged this; it is not yet done.
